reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (Nevada, 2021)
    Encodes NV unlawful detainer statutes relevant to eviction for breach of lease/rental agreement/rules.

    Question: "Can a landlord evict a tenant for breach/breaking the lease, the rental agreement, or a landlord's rule?"
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic domain model (people, property, tenancy, possession, consent, notices)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% scenario entities
tenant(t1).
landlord(l1).
property(p1).

% Property type / regulatory regime (used by NRS 40.251(1)(b))
dwelling_unit(p1).
subject_to_chapter_118a(p1).  % "dwelling unit subject to chapter 118A of NRS"

% Possession and consent (common elements across the statutes)
tenant_continues_in_possession(Tenant, Property) :-
    continues_in_possession(Tenant, Property).

landlord_lacks_consent(Tenant, Property) :-
    no_landlord_consent(Tenant, Property).

% Notice abstraction
% notice(Type, Days) where Type is an atom describing the statutory notice purpose.
notice_served(Tenant, Property, Type, Days) :-
    served_notice(Tenant, Property, Type, Days).

notice_expired(Tenant, Property, Type) :-
    expired_notice(Tenant, Property, Type).

% Helper: notice of at least N days was served and expired
notice_of_at_least_days_served_and_expired(Tenant, Property, Type, MinDays) :-
    notice_served(Tenant, Property, Type, Days),
    integer(Days),
    Days >= MinDays,
    notice_expired(Tenant, Property, Type).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations (deterministic predicates capturing the statutes)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  NV Rev Stat  40.251(1)(b)(2) (2021)
  For a dwelling unit subject to chapter 118A:
  Unlawful detainer when tenant continues in possession without landlord consent after
  expiration of a notice of at least 5 days where tenant failed to perform basic/contractual
  obligations under chapter 118A (often called "5-day notice to perform or quit").
*/
statute_40_251_1b2_unlawful_detainer(Tenant, Property) :-
    dwelling_unit(Property),
    subject_to_chapter_118a(Property),
    tenant_failed_basic_or_contractual_obligation_under_118a(Tenant, Property),
    notice_of_at_least_days_served_and_expired(Tenant, Property, notice_to_perform_or_quit, 5),
    tenant_continues_in_possession(Tenant, Property),
    landlord_lacks_consent(Tenant, Property),
    !.

/*
  NV Rev Stat  40.2514 (2021)
  Specific serious breaches (e.g., unlawful business, nuisance, waste, prohibited sublet, etc.):
  Unlawful detainer when tenant remains in possession after service of 3 days' notice to surrender.
*/
statute_40_2514_unlawful_detainer(Tenant, Property) :-
    statute_40_2514_breach_event(Tenant, Property),
    notice_of_at_least_days_served_and_expired(Tenant, Property, notice_to_surrender, 3),
    tenant_continues_in_possession(Tenant, Property),
    landlord_lacks_consent(Tenant, Property),
    !.

/* NV Rev Stat  40.2514(1)-(5) (2021): enumerated breach events */
statute_40_2514_breach_event(Tenant, Property) :-
    assigns_or_sublets_contrary_to_covenant(Tenant, Property),
    !.
statute_40_2514_breach_event(Tenant, Property) :-
    commits_or_permits_waste(Tenant, Property),
    !.
statute_40_2514_breach_event(Tenant, Property) :-
    carries_on_unlawful_business(Tenant, Property),
    !.
statute_40_2514_breach_event(Tenant, Property) :-
    maintains_nuisance(Tenant, Property),
    !.
statute_40_2514_breach_event(Tenant, Property) :-
    violates_controlled_substances_law_on_premises(Tenant, Property),
    !.

/*
  NV Rev Stat  40.2512 (2021) (nonpayment) is included for completeness, but the question
  is about breach/lease/rules. Still, it is part of the unlawful detainer framework.
*/
statute_40_2512_unlawful_detainer_nonpayment(Tenant, Property) :-
    default_in_payment_of_rent(Tenant, Property),
    notice_of_at_least_days_served_and_expired(Tenant, Property, pay_or_quit, 7),
    tenant_continues_in_possession(Tenant, Property),
    landlord_lacks_consent(Tenant, Property),
    \+ shutdown_worker_exception_applies(Tenant),
    !.

% NV Rev Stat  40.2512(2) (2021): shutdown worker exception
shutdown_worker_exception_applies(Tenant) :-
    is_shutdown_worker_or_household_member(Tenant),
    provides_proof_of_shutdown_status(Tenant),
    !.
shutdown_worker_exception_applies(_Tenant) :-
    fail.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Consolidated legal conclusions
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% A tenant is in unlawful detainer if any statute-defined pathway is satisfied.
unlawful_detainer(Tenant, Property, breach_basic_or_contractual_obligation_118a) :-
    statute_40_251_1b2_unlawful_detainer(Tenant, Property),
    !.
unlawful_detainer(Tenant, Property, serious_breach_40_2514) :-
    statute_40_2514_unlawful_detainer(Tenant, Property),
    !.
unlawful_detainer(Tenant, Property, nonpayment_40_2512) :-
    statute_40_2512_unlawful_detainer_nonpayment(Tenant, Property),
    !.

% Eviction is legally supportable (for this simplified QA) if tenant is in unlawful detainer.
landlord_can_evict_for_breach(Tenant, Property) :-
    unlawful_detainer(Tenant, Property, _Reason),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (encoding the question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  The question asks about eviction for breach/breaking the lease/rental agreement/landlord rule.
  We encode a concrete instance of that question:
  - Tenant violated a landlord rule that is part of the rental agreement/tenant obligations
  - Landlord served the statutory 5-day notice to perform or quit (NRS 40.251(1)(b)(2))
  - Notice expired; tenant remained; landlord did not consent
*/

% "Breach/breaking the lease, rental agreement, or landlord's rule"
violated_landlord_rule(t1, p1).
landlord_rule_is_contractual_obligation_under_118a(t1, p1).

% Map the rule violation to "failed to perform the tenant's basic or contractual obligations"
tenant_failed_basic_or_contractual_obligation_under_118a(Tenant, Property) :-
    violated_landlord_rule(Tenant, Property),
    landlord_rule_is_contractual_obligation_under_118a(Tenant, Property),
    !.

% Notice and continued possession
served_notice(t1, p1, notice_to_perform_or_quit, 5).
expired_notice(t1, p1, notice_to_perform_or_quit).

continues_in_possession(t1, p1).
no_landlord_consent(t1, p1).

/* Scenario summary predicate required by prompt */
scenario_statement :-
    tenant(t1),
    landlord(l1),
    property(p1),
    dwelling_unit(p1),
    subject_to_chapter_118a(p1),
    tenant_failed_basic_or_contractual_obligation_under_118a(t1, p1),
    notice_of_at_least_days_served_and_expired(t1, p1, notice_to_perform_or_quit, 5),
    tenant_continues_in_possession(t1, p1),
    landlord_lacks_consent(t1, p1),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Answer predicate (deterministic yes/no)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    landlord_can_evict_for_breach(t1, p1),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Can a landlord evict a tenant for breach/breaking the lease, the rental agreement, or a landlord’s rule?
